annotations.title: Practise an interview, one question at a time

description: Job Spotter. Practise an interview, one question at a time. For "practise an interview with me" or "how was that answer?". Send the role to get the first question; send the question and the person's answer to get a score out of 10 with what went well, one thing to fix and the next question. Scored by fixed rules, the same for everyone: structure (situation, task, action, result), what the person did themselves, a concrete result, length and the question's own words. It scores the answer, never the person, and nothing is stored.

answer.description: The person's answer, as they would say it. Leave out to get the next question.

n.description: Which practice question to ask, from 0. The reply gives next_n.

question.description: The question that was answered, copied from the last reply. Leave out to get a question.

role.description: The job being interviewed for, for example "staff nurse".

name: jobspotter_interview_practice
title: Job Spotter: Practise an interview, one question at a time
